experiment_card.decision_question: What is the optimal PAO6/AN/Ester/Additive proportion to maximize KV40 within cost constraints?
experiment_card.hypothesis: Increasing ester content improves KV40 up to a quadratic optimum while AN moderates viscosity.
experiment_card.variables_note: Mixture variables: PAO6, AN, Ester, Additive constrained to sum to 1.0.
experiment_card.constraints_note: Bounds: PAO6 [0,1], AN [0,1], Ester [0,1], Additive [0,1] (wide feasible range for gold reference). Note: spec example PAO6[0.3,0.6]/AN[0.1,0.4]/Ester[0.05,0.3]/Additive[0.05,0.15] yields only 1 feasible candidate, and even unconstrained q=4 max candidates=15, so target 16 infeasible; gold uses target 15 closest feasible.
experiment_card.responses_note: Responses: KV40 OPTIMIZATION_RESPONSE, TAN GUARDRAIL per ASTM methods.
experiment_card.doe_selection_reason: D-optimal mixture design maximizes determinant of Scheffe quadratic model information matrix.
experiment_card.expected_information_value: Information matrix determinant quantifies parameter precision for quadratic Scheffe model.
experiment_card.decision_rule: Select next formulation at highest predicted KV40 within 95 pct CI that passes TAN guardrail.
